item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In 2020, mobile military courts enabled prosecution and conviction of 103 members of the national armed forces and 28 members of the national police; however, court-ordered reparations had yet to be paid.","notes":["The excerpt does not specify that the convictions were for 'violations'; that wording was removed."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Across North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri, 5.5 million people were displaced and an estimated 220,000 were pregnant; in 2023, more than 313,000 women and girls would be at risk, while UNFPA's appeal to scale services was only 16% funded.","notes":["The excerpt says women and girls 'will be at risk,' not that they 'were expected' to be at risk."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"RSF reported that the national broadcaster lacked independence; politicians, local authorities, militias, and religious groups pressured journalists; journalists faced arrests, threats, disappearances, and attacks; and security forces were involved in many abuses with impunity. In North Kivu, journalists faced harassment and reprisals from the beginning of 2023, while discouraging the armed forces through the media in wartime was punishable by death.","notes":["The excerpt specifies 'discouraging the armed forces via the media,' which is narrower than general wartime criticism."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On November 21, 2023, the Congolese foreign minister and the head of MONUSCO co-signed a note containing a plan and timeline for the accelerated, gradual, orderly, and responsible withdrawal of MONUSCO, including complete disengagement from the DRC.","notes":["The excerpt says they co-signed a note containing the plan and timeline, not that they directly co-signed the plan itself."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
